Rate Modulators (flow -> direction; form: faction_rally (target; shifts Ideo·X DOWN → Collectivist; plane→polar, raises faction.cohesion); artifact_devote (target; shifts Ideo·X DOWN → Collectivist; plane→polar, raises artifact.power); settlement_propaganda (target; drift); faction_indoctrinate (target; drift)
column13: Plane rows: 'Inflow'/'Outflow' columns mean axis shift UP/DOWN, not stock gain/loss. attune and cleanse shift NPC values UP on their axes. rally and devote shift Ideo·X DOWN (toward Collectivist) as collectivist actions — these are plane→polar where the polar target (cohesion, power) rises. Propaganda/indoctrinate are context-dependent drifts toward partner state.
